output.reason: The brief backs its claim with specific comparisons: Corvane tags printed locally fail far more often than Corvane transfer tags or Pelion tags, which go through the same crews, encode bags are arriving after laterals close, and in the 14–16 October test the Brackwater stock read normally on counters while the Fennick stock failed on kiosks. Its actions are clear and reversible, though that test compared counters with kiosks, so the kiosks' cut in printer cleaning (weekly to fortnightly) isn't fully ruled out as the cause.
